description: This bar chart, titled “Average Performance,” illustrates the comparative average performance scores for five different methods: “Standard,” “Self-RAG,” “FactTune,” “ClinGS (w/)”, and “ClinGS.” The horizontal axis lists these five methods as categorical labels, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents “Average Performance,” scaled linearly from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each method is represented by a single, solid-colored vertical bar. The “Standard” method is shown as an orange bar with an approximate value of 55. The “Self-RAG” method is depicted as a tan bar, also approximately 55. The “FactTune” method is shown as a lime-green bar, with a value of approximately 53. The “ClinGS (w/)” method is represented by a blue bar, also approximately 53. The “ClinGS” method is shown as a darker blue bar, reaching the highest value on the chart at approximately 60. The bars are sorted in descending order of performance from left to right, with the highest-performing method (“ClinGS”) on the far right. There are no visual annotations, shading, or emphasis applied to any specific bars.
